tuning.decision: GroupNorm (8 groups) with SGD lr=0.05 and K=20 local steps provides strictly monotonic post-round-15 convergence (AUC 0.7285 -> 0.7770 -> 0.8273 -> 0.8510) and outperforms FedAvg-SGD (0.7845) by +0.0665 without BN client drift collapse.

scratch_on_target.description: Same architecture trained from random init on the same 20% target split (no source pre-training); reference for the fine-tuned row

cross_dataset_transfer.source_model: centrally trained on the shared-feature subset (not the FL checkpoint)
cross_dataset_transfer.feature_space_note: Edge-IIoTset is packet-level; WUSTL-IIoT-2021 is flow-level. Only 3 semantically shared features exist; zero-shot transfer is reported as a negative result.
